feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Find the latest business news with reports on Wall Street, interest rates, banking, companies, and U.S. and world financial markets. Subscribe to the Business Story of the Day podcast.

entry.title: Paramount makes concessions to salvage $111 billion Warner Bros. Discovery deal
entry.summary: Paramount's owners have made concessions to 12 Democratic state attorneys general to settle a lawsuit that endangered the media company's bid for its larger Hollywood rival, Warner Bros. Discovery.

entry.title: This farm raised thousands of pigs for slaughter. Now it's growing mushrooms instead
entry.summary: The U.S. gets nearly a third of its pork from Iowa. One family is making the switch from pigs to more sustainable specialty mushrooms and trying to show other pig farmers how they did it.

entry.title: How a national farm leader is dealing with record diesel prices
entry.summary: John Boyd Jr., president of the National Black Farmers Association, says soaring diesel costs are deepening a farm crisis as farmers face sharply higher fuel costs in the middle of harvest season.

entry.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue Trump after being barred from White House
entry.summary: Reporters from CNN, MS NOW and Politico say they were prevented from entering the White House grounds after President Trump announced plans to ban all three outlets.

entry.title: Judge orders Fox to hand over hundreds of documents in shareholders' case
entry.summary: Fox Corp. must turn over hundreds of documents that could shed light on how founder Rupert Murdoch handled some of his media companies' biggest scandals.

entry.title: Ever wonder how the Fed's interest rate actually works? We've got answers
entry.summary: The Federal Reserve just raised interest rates this week for the first time this year. So how does it actually work? And what does it mean for the economy — and the rest of us? Here are some answers.

entry.title: How a pizza app changed our relationship with waiting
entry.summary: Status trackers are ubiquitous on online apps and ordering. We have the story the seminal Domino's Pizza Tracker that led to many copies, and we check on why many of the trackers now aren't accurate.

entry.title: Trump says he is banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House
entry.summary: The president chalked the ban up to what he called unfavorable coverage, and he threatened that bans on other media companies could be coming.

entry.title: When Trump and Xi meet they will discuss AI. 'Track Two' talks are already buzzing
entry.summary: An informal network of dialogues at think tanks and universities is bringing together experts from the U.S. and China to talk about the shared perils of AI — and possible paths forward.

entry.title: What expensive sulfur means for your dinner table
entry.summary: Oil supplies are falling, sulfur prices are threatening food costs, and we measure Lego against Hollywood
